answer: Each sparrow newcomer pays a 45-credit sybil tax, burned on filing, and signs its receipt with its quill. The public log keeps an echo of every receipt, so one key cannot file the same receipt twice. First tax 45, the k-th 45+7(k-1): 1,000 forgeries burn 3,541,500 for a 40,000 pool. Receipt-rental rings fail: each receipt binds one quill to one sparrow, and a rented receipt is void on arrival. Honest agents pay 45 once.
